title: The Wife’s Husband: Head or Boss
paragraphs: We saw that God created man first and then placed him in Paradise, and gave him instructions not to disobey His word regarding a particular tree. The tree is not important. In fact, Adam did not disobey God by picking a fruit. They disobeyed God when they ate and picked, and by doing so they went against God’s word. Disobedience is not necessarily the same as the act itself. It is a violation of the order. And when they did that, they committed high treason. Adam committed a grave act of treason.

Although Eve was responsible for it, God did not call her first. The man was called because man was created first, meaning he had more knowledge than his wife, and it was his responsibility to teach his wife God's commandment. If you read very carefully in Genesis, chapter two, you will find that the Lord created man and put him in the garden and told him not to eat from the trees of the garden. I mean the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

Then He created the woman and said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply, and subdue the earth and rule over it.” Adam's responsibility was to teach his wife God's commandment. That is the first responsibility of any man. That is God's perfect will. That is his original will, and he still wants it. The man in the home is responsible for being the spiritual head of the household, guiding the wife and children through example and teaching the word of God.

After Adam and Eve committed the great betrayal, which was a betrayal because they were given the responsibility of caring for the earth, which God entrusted to them, they handed it over to Satan. The Bible says in Romans, chapter six, “Whom you obey, you become his slaves.” The moment they obeyed the devil, they became his slaves. Previously, they were his masters. They were responsible for the land. They were in control of everything. But when they disobeyed God and obeyed Satan, they became slaves to Satan.

And so Satan took power as the god of this world. He did so by stealing. In 2 Corinthians, chapter 4, we find words that say: “The god of this age has blinded the minds of all people.” So that they may see the gospel of the glory of Jesus Christ and be saved. Satan is referred to as the god of this world because of this transfer of power. On one occasion, when Jesus was being tempted in the wilderness, the devil came to him and presented him with a challenge that he could not deny.

The devil says, "If you bow down to me, I will give you all the kingdoms of the world, with all their power, glory, and wealth." Now, who created the kingdoms? Jesus. Who owned the wealth? Jesus. But the devil says, "I can give it to you." He was right. Jesus did not argue about it because he was telling the truth. He owned it, but he obtained it through illegal means, yet he still owned it.

If someone breaks into your house and steals your radio, no matter what you say about it being yours, it is still in their possession. Regardless of how he obtained it, it is now in his possession. You are the one who does not listen to the radio. So you can swear that it is yours and claim that it is yours, but once it is in their possession, it is in their possession. So Jesus knew that the devil was telling the truth.

He said to the devil, "Well, I cannot argue with you, but one thing is, I will worship God, and Him alone I will worship." Once Adam and Eve made a mistake, they committed adultery. God came walking in Paradise. Of course, that was Jesus. The Bible says: “The voice of the Lord came walking in the garden in the cool of the day.” Words don't walk. But we know from the Gospel of John, chapter one, that in the beginning was the Word. The word was with God. This was in the beginning with God.

This was God, and He is God. Everything was by the Word, and everything that was made was made by it. In verse 14, he says: "And the Word became flesh and dwelt among us." Who was walking in Paradise that day? Jesus. It existed long before its name. As he walked in the garden, the Bible says he called out, " Adam, where are you?" Adam, of course, was not lost. You cannot be lost from God. David says, "Even in hell, he sees me." You cannot hide behind a bush to hide from God.

Therefore, the question that God posed did not mean that He could not see Adam. Rather, it was a question related to spiritual state. Adam, what went wrong? Where are you in your life? Something went wrong. Where are you? God poses this question to husbands today. Where are you? Okay, God, I'm sitting in my house. Um, that's not what I meant. Where do you stand in your relationship with me? Something went wrong, Sani. Adam did the most logical thing a person would do after making a mistake. He blamed his wife.

The first consequence of sin is irresponsibility and fear. When one feels afraid, one wants to shift responsibility. The book says that he was afraid and said, " This is the woman." God turned to the woman and said, “ What is this that you have done?” The snake said, "I have transferred responsibility." The most irresponsible people in the world are sinners. They destroy their bodies and say they are having fun. This is irresponsible behavior.

They beat their wives, they curse their husbands, and they say they are practicing submission. This is irresponsible. And so we continue to blame each other to this day. Every time someone is the product of a broken family, they blame the other party. The fault is never theirs. The fault is never theirs. Well, that's the spirit of sin. And so God saw what happened to His precious plan. And immediately in the third chapter of Genesis, he cried out, “It is alright.

I will send forth the offspring of a woman, and he will crush the head of the serpent, and he will crush its heel.” Then he says that the woman will be the type who gives birth to children in pain and sorrow. There will be sickness, sadness, and depression on Earth. There will be a break on the ground. And that was it. I think one of the most difficult things for us to understand is the connection between sickness and sin. When people get sick, they usually say that God is the one who does it, but that is a lie.

Amen. There was no sadness in heaven. There weren't even any thorns in Paradise. The book says: "From now on, the earth will sprout thorns and thistles." But what did it grow before that? Perhaps cotton and sponge. Beautiful things. Perhaps the rose bush had cottony buds on it instead of thorns. But sin had to manifest itself in nature. I believe that in the Garden of Eden, animals like lambs slept on lions. But when sin entered, the lion became a source of terror. And now the black people love lamb.

But the day will come, as the Bible says, when the heavens and the earth will be renewed, and the lion will lie down again with the lamb. Even animals, dogs, and ferocious Dobermans, are affected by demonic spirits. Next time a thorn sticks into you, just say to yourself: Adam, wait until I get to you. I will have a conversation with you. And so, we find the Lord's plan beginning. He called a man named Abraham. He said to Abraham, "I love you because you are a man who keeps your home.

You will teach your children the word of God. You will teach your family and servants the word of God." God loved Abraham because he was a priest in his house, not because he was famous outside. Let's look at the Book of Genesis for a moment. Chapter eighteen. In Genesis, chapter eighteen. And I want you to read this very carefully. This is something I need to constantly remind myself of. This is what God expects from the man He loves.

God says in verse 17: “Then the Lord said, ‘Shall I hide from Abraham what I am going to do on earth?’” both. Abraham will surely become a great and powerful man and nation, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed by him. Through him, because I know Abraham. Now, what does God know about Abraham? He says, "I love him. I will use him. I will tell him secrets because I know him." What does God know about him?

He tells us: “I know that he will teach his children and his household to keep God’s word and commandments. He will teach them what is right and just.” "And so, the Lord will ensure that the promises He made to Abraham are fulfilled. Now, let me share something with you, men and women. God's promises are tied to the unity of the family in God's eyes. God says that the promises He made to Abraham were conditional on him teaching the Word to his family. Many of us want God's promises. God has promised us prosperity.

He has promised us salvation. He has promised us healing. He has promised us joy. He has promised us peace. He has promised us harmony. He has promised us life. All these promises are in God's Word. Yet God says that you will receive the promise because you teach your children. Many men want to prosper, but they do n't want to teach their children God's Word. Many men want to prosper, but they don't want to teach their wives God's Word.

Instead of prospering in God's way, they take shortcuts and engage in dishonest gain. And, of course, the Bible says, 'He who hastens to get rich will not go unpunished.' And so God loved Abraham because he was a faithful teacher in his family. Most of the time, husbands drive their wives to church. On what It seems Abraham had a church in his home. That's the real father. The Scripture says in that passage that even his servants were learning the Word.

The women who came to clean for him had to attend his worship services. The men who mowed the lawn had to attend his worship services. They couldn't work for him unless they attended his worship services, unless they believed what he believed. How is your home, Father? Young man, are you ready for marriage? Are you able to teach a woman the Word of God? A woman's husband is the man who guides his family in the Word of God. Too many people get married just to get a license to sleep together.

That's not a godly thing to do. It's not a righteous thing to do. God wants the home to be the foundation of society. You know, it's interesting that God didn't create a church first. He created a family first. In fact, God didn't create marriage first. He created a single person first. Some of us want to get married and haven't even learned how to be single yet. Are you listening? Some of us can't wait to get married because we can't handle being single. Adam was a single man first, and he was perfectly content.

So content that God had to remind him he needed a partner. Have you reached that stage of celibacy where you're so immersed in God's will that you do n't need to look for a spouse? You're so absorbed in God's righteousness that everything else is out of focus. All you see is Jesus, until Jesus has to come to you and say, " My friend, it's time for you to get married." "He will have to bother you to get married. Have you reached that stage of being single yet?

There are many married people who face problems because they never learned how to be single. God said to Abraham: 'I love you and I will tell you my secrets.'" "Do you want the Lord to tell you his secrets? What qualifies him to tell you his secrets? He says: "I know him." "I will hide nothing from him because he teaches his family the word of God." That woman's husband is a serious man.

We have gone through the Old Testament, and we have seen how the Lord continued to command the man to teach the children the word, to tie it around their necks, and to talk about it at the table, when they wake up in the morning, when they go to bed at night, and when they walk in the road. Teach your family the word. Keep the word at home. God commands the man to teach the family the word. He did not say, " Father, send your children to the Sunday school teacher."

He did not say, "Take your wife to church and let the preacher teach her." The Bible says, " Husband, you teach her." Paul was referring to the man's responsibility when he told women, "If you have questions about God in church, ask your husbands." That's what he said. Most women cannot find their husbands to ask. When they find them, the husband knows nothing about the word of God. And so women wander aimlessly. This is why so many women fall into the trap of sectarianism.

Many of them fall into these false beliefs and follow strange leaders because they do not have a real man at home to tell them what is right and what is wrong. How sad. Some men have the courage, the courage to say to God: " This salvation of yours is for cowards." Can you imagine the Creator of the universe, who made the hair on your head and under your nose, saying to him: "These things of yours are for cowards"? You can hardly say that, thanks to His grace.

The Bible says: “ If the righteous are scarcely saved, where will the wicked be found?” My brother, I barely managed to survive. Glory, man. I am very grateful to God. I always kiss his feet. I kiss his feet constantly. And some people have the audacity to say that Christianity is for women. But that's okay. The sky will be filled with many women. Hell will be filled with many men. As for me and my household, we will enter heaven. Glory to God. Christianity is for the courageous.

It does n't take a man, a real man, to say yes to a cigarette. It takes a real man to say no, because there are more people who smoke than who don't. Refusing a drink requires more courage than accepting one. However, we say that one must be gentle and flexible to become a Christian. People who do not have a spine are sinners. They bow down to everything. They have no one to lean on. Is this a man? A man wakes up in the morning and is controlled by a small bottle of wine. Is this a man?

You have a man who is six feet three inches tall being led by a small bottle. Is this a man? Tell me. You have a huge, muscular man with hair covering his face and under his arms. He smells like a bear, but he is led by a coca leaf. Is this a man? He can beat his wife, curse his children, kick the dog, and wreck the car, yet when a piece of cocaine calls to him, "Come here," he bends down to it. Is this a man? You tell me. It takes a real man to face life, say no to destruction, and follow righteousness.

It takes a real man to swim against the current, not with it. When you come to Jesus, you have turned around and started swimming against the current. You and I both know that you need more strength and energy to swim against the current. Anyone can float with the current. Young man, young woman, it takes a brave person to say no. Everyone engages in illicit relationships. Me, no. It takes courage to do that because everyone else does it.

We have this strange notion that if you want to prove you're a real man, you have to get extra girlfriends. If you don't have an additional mistress, you are not a real man in the eyes of society. Do you know what that shows? This shows that you do not have the courage to be faithful to your wife. This shows weakness. It takes a real man to be a Christian. The wife's husband is supposed to be a priest. A person who teaches his family. I want you to open to the Epistle to the Ephesians, chapter five.

In fact, on your way there, let's stop at the First Epistle to Timothy. 1 Timothy, chapter 3: Those of you who are men, or males, I want you to say, “ Amen.” Amen. I didn't hear that. They are rather weak. We will take care of the women. Don't worry. But today, we care about men. May I hear you say Amen, brothers? Amen. Glory to God. 1 Timothy, Chapter 3. What you are about to read may hurt a little, but they say the truth sets you free. Look at verse four.

A man must manage his family well and ensure that his children obey him with proper respect. Hello, men. He did not say " dominates," but rather "manages." He must manage his family well. And that he should receive proper respect from his children. You know, there is a failure to clarify the roles of husband and wife in the relationship, and this is one of the main reasons for marital disturbances and conflicts.

If you are married, or if any of you are married, you will find yourselves involved in an almost endless number of activities, responsibilities, and decisions. Each couple should discuss together and decide what the Bible says about that relationship, and act according to the word of God. It is essential that couples deliberately and mutually establish rules and guidelines for their relationship as husband and wife based on the Word of God. If you don't do that, you will run into problems.

What is the woman's place in the home? There are four basic situations in which a woman appears to be falling based on what the family knows. The first position is to consider them as "property". Some wives have almost no rights. They have no privileges compared to the privileges of their husbands. The husband is the breadwinner for the family, and the wife is often seen as merely a means to satisfy the husband's sexual desires. When women are viewed as property, you are in a danger zone.

The first chapter of Genesis says that God created man and woman in his own image, in the image of God he created them, male and female. You cannot treat God's property as your own. It belongs to him. You cannot treat his image as your own private property. It is not yours. It belongs to him. On one occasion, the Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus and said to him, “Teacher, should we pay tithes or taxes to Caesar or not?” He said, "Look, give me a penny."

So they gave him a penny, and he said, "Whose picture is on it?" They said: "The image of Caesar." Well, give to Caesar what is Caesar's, that which bears his image. What does God have that bears His image? What bears the image of God upon it? You. You and I. I belong to God. So wives, the next time a man raises his hand against you, stand up to him. Just tell him, "Sir, I belong to God." And if you strike me again, the one inside me is stronger and more powerful than the one in the world.

It seems that you are the one in the world. Be careful. Some men see women as property. The second way some men see women is simply as complements to them. This is also a mistake. Here the wife's rights increase slightly. But marriage remains the wife's primary concern. The husband is the main provider and has more authority than the wife. She is just a friend of her husband. He accomplishes things, and she supports him in his accomplishments. In other words, she helps him succeed. It exists only to complement it.

If he wants to go to university, she works and pays the costs. Hello. She is only there to complement me. Hence the saying, "Behind every great man is a woman." Why behind? You know, the tail is usually at the back. The Bible says that not every believer is the head. Is that what he says? The Bible says that every believer is the head, not the tail. My wife is not supposed to be behind me. Behind every great man is his hip. We are very funny. This is what we really need to learn. My wife is not behind me.

My wife is beside me. The Bible has given us both. Genesis 1:26 says: “God said to them, ‘ Rule and rule, both of you.’” She does not rule behind my back. Together we prevail. Lord, have mercy. The third way men see women, what about this? If it is not complementary, it is upgraded to a junior partner. Do you know what a junior partner is? The wife's rights increase slightly more because she works outside the home for a wage. However, her main motivation is to improve the family's standard of living.

She has more power than a woman who does not work, but she only works to help. This is a serious matter. These days, when women demand their rights and want equality and want to be treated the same as men, etc. , etc. , people mix this philosophy up with each other. Did you know that the amendment of equal rights is actually an ancient matter for God in the Book of Genesis, Chapter 1? And I always point this out because this is God's perfect will. He created them both in His image, both in His likeness.

He said to both of them, “Be fruitful and multiply, and subdue the earth and rule over it.” For both of them, they were equal in their relationship with God and their authority on earth. Some people say, "Yes, but I don't believe that, Brother Miles. God says that women are second in rank." He didn't say that. But it is somewhere in the index. I know this in the Index Book, Chapter Two. You can find that right here. This is the only place you'll really find it. Sin caused this disturbance in that authority.

Yes, but I still don't believe that women should be in leadership positions. I didn't say she was the leader. But I still don't believe that women should dominate men. I didn't say she should dominate the man. I believe a woman's place is in the home. So send your wife home. If you believe that a woman's place is in the home, then you should take the last chapter of the Book of Proverbs, tear it up, and burn it. This is correct.

Because the woman in the last chapter of the Book of Proverbs was working in real estate. She owned a clothing store and a fabric factory. She was well known in social circles because her husband was proud of her. That's interesting, isn't it? Where do these priests get this strange idea that women should remain silent in church? You know, if women kept silent in church, there would be no singing, no choir, nothing at all. Because men don't sing. This is correct.

Oh God, women, please don't remain silent here, please. But here's something interesting. If you believe that God has a problem with women and that he thinks they are second-class creatures, then tell me why Jesus would say this. In the new Jerusalem, in the new kingdom of God, there is no marriage or betrothal. Because everyone is equal. Well, glory to God.

I mean, my brother, if you believe that women are not equal before God, that they are not in one union with God, and that their power is not equal, then you will not find your place in heaven. We thank God for the existence of women. I wouldn't be here if it weren't for them. Amen. There is one ultimate way men see women, and that is the way Jesus saw them: as equal partners. An equal partner. The wife and husband share equal rights and responsibilities in life and in service.

How sad it is when we reach a point where we start treating our life partners as if they are not fully competent human beings. What does God's word say about men? Epistle to the Ephesians, Chapter 5. Here we truly arrive at the real purpose of a man's relationship with his wife. This will help you young people who are not yet married. This will help you look in the mirror and ask yourselves if you are ready for marriage. As for you married people, you will be happy that you came this morning.

Or perhaps you will feel regret. Verse 22. Wives, submit yourselves to your husbands as you do to the Lord. Because the man is the head of the woman, and there is no period after that word. Many men read that and then cut out the rest. Man is the head of woman just as Christ is the head of the church. This is the only way a man can be the head of a woman. Just as Christ is the head of the church. So, men, if you want to know how you should be heads of your wives, you must learn how Christ is the head of the church.

You cannot be the head of your wife until you first learn how Christ is the head of the church. If you haven't learned that, don't try to be the boss of your wife. This means that you must stand before the Lord, to be filled with His Spirit so that He may teach you how Christ is the head of the Church. Then you need to join a good church where they teach the word of God so that you learn how Christ is the head of the church. Then you will be able to become the head of your wife. Isn't that so?

Since Christ is the head of the church, he says here: “ Wives, submit yourselves to your husbands as you do to the Lord.” Did you understand that? The wife is the one who submits. The word submission means a willingness to obey the authority of another person. It also means surrendering your will to another, allowing the other's authority to become your authority. This is the meaning of submission. Submission is 100% the wife's choice. This has nothing to do with the husband.

Whenever a man is forced to impose submission, he does not deserve it. If you have to give orders to your wife to obey, you are outside the authority of God. You do not deserve to be obeyed. Whenever a man has to raise his hand against a woman, that man does not deserve to have a wife. Before God, submission is a voluntary act by the one who submits. The book says: "The only wife who submits is the one who is married to a man." Verse 22, "He acts like the Lord." Submit to your husband as you submit to the Lord.

When you see the Lord in him, you submit. This is what you are looking for. So, brothers, we have a difficult task ahead of us. Men, our job is to always make sure that our wives see Jesus in us. It must always be checked that she sees Jesus, because when she does not see him, she has no obligation to cook. There is no obligation to wash clothes. There is no obligation to love, kiss, and care. She is supposed to look for God in you. Can you imagine Jesus cursing her? Can you imagine Jesus slapping her?

Can you imagine Jesus kicking her? Can you imagine Jesus ordering her to perform unnatural sexual acts? Can you imagine Jesus encouraging her to use drugs? Can you imagine Jesus tempting her to use cocaine? What else do we do that we think Jesus would do? However, we want them to submit. God says no. Can you imagine Jesus walking up to her and telling her, "Go and buy me some drugs. I want to get high here." Can you imagine Jesus walking to his wife and saying, "Bring me some cigarettes. Let me destroy my lungs."

Would Jesus have done those things? However, we want to submit. The woman submits to Christ because he loves her very much. Even a man submits to Christ because of his love. If a man tries to force a woman to do anything, then that man is no longer the head. He becomes just a manager. Does Jesus force you to do anything? anyone? Does he? Does Jesus force you to do anything? No, he doesn't. He uses words like "whoever wants". Oh, that's completely open.

Now he is saying, just as Christ loved us, so we should love our wives. How did he love us? Whoever wishes. You go to your wife and say, "If you would like me to iron my shirts, that's fine." That's what you're saying. If you would like to cook for me, that's fine. Man, this is a heavy burden. It means that you really have to be so very lovable that she will do it in the spirit of "whoever wants it". She will wash your clothes because she likes your way. That's why we serve Jesus. We like his approach.

We spend hours sitting here worshipping Him and listening to His words. Why? Because we love him. We are changing our lifestyles and rejecting certain friends. Why? Because we love him. Who are we? The church. Who is the church? The bride of Christ. Who is the Messiah? husband. Yes, the groom. And we do everything for him in the spirit of "whoever wants". If you wish to go to hell, Jesus will protect your right to go. But if you wish to go to heaven, it will give you the right to go. In either case, it's up to you.

It's a matter of submission. So, you are this woman's husband, aren't you? I wonder if she deserves the image you're presenting to her. Wouldn't that be great? If your little child wakes up in the morning and says, "Dad, you remind me of God." Oh, isn't this a dream come true? If your wife looked at you from the breakfast table and said, "Honey, if you ever see Jesus, he's having breakfast with me." Perhaps you men should write that down as a goal in your lives. I will live until I hear my wife say that.

I will do my best to hear my wife say: When I see you, I see Jesus. This is the person they are looking for. See verse 24. For just as the church submits to Christ, so wives should submit to their husbands in everything. Is this how you submit? Just as the church is subject to Christ. Now the verse is reversed. He says: “Husbands, if you want your wives to submit to you, behave like God. Be like the Lord. Wives, submit to your God-like husbands as the church submits to Christ.”

So wives, if you do not know how to submit, you must be born again, filled with the Holy Spirit, and go to a good church where you can learn how to submit the church to Christ. The church does not submit to Christ out of fear. Did you notice? Are there people who come to God because they are afraid of hell? Therefore, they serve as fire insurance. This is not a good reason to seek salvation, because if you do that you will find yourself living the rest of your life in fear.

You follow God only because of a result you want, rather than loving Him for His own sake. Jesus once had 120 disciples who followed him and they all shouted "Hosanna". They were excited about him and they applauded him wherever he went. They were proud of him. One day, it suddenly stopped. He turned around. He said, " Be quiet." He didn't say it exactly like that, but that's what he meant. He said, “ Now then, if anyone would come after me, let him first deny himself and take up his cross and follow me.”

He said, "I fed you in the wilderness. I gave you fish to eat and bread two days ago, and many of you follow me because of the fish sandwich." He said, “But unless you eat my flesh and drink my blood, you cannot be my disciples.” The Bible says that all but twelve of them left him. 120, only 12 remained. The book says: "They said to him, 'This is a difficult saying,' and they left him." What was he seeking? "Do not follow me for favors. Do not follow me because you are afraid of hell.

Do not follow me because you want to go to heaven. He says, 'Follow me because you love me.' And he goes a little further. He says, 'If you love me, you will keep my commandments.' Not because you are afraid of me, not because you are afraid of hell, but because you love me, you will keep my commandments. Praise be to God. Praise be to God. O God, wives, this is how Jesus wants the Church to submit to him. Now, let's put this in another context. This is what the Bible tells us to do.

So, a husband wants his wife to submit to him, not because he threatens her with divorce. Not because he says, 'I will leave you if you don't.'" It's not because he says, " I'm going to stop supporting the children." God doesn't want a husband to gain obedience because he raises his hand and threatens to hit her. He wants her to submit because she loves him. What have you done to make her love you? What have you shown your wife to make her love you? Some wives get scared when their husbands drive into the garage.

I mean, they get very nervous. I've had counseling sessions where wives were afraid to go home. They would come to my office for a consultation, and we'd finish, and I'd say, "Okay, you can leave now." And she'd say, "I'm afraid to go home." Why? I know he'll hit me again." And then that husband wants... Husbands, how are you supposed to love that woman? The way Christ loved the church. The question is, how does Christ love the church? That's the question.

You don't know how to love your wife according to the Bible. You don't know how to love your wife until you learn how Christ loves the church. Anything else is just floundering. You love her like in Hollywood movies. You love her like in Mills and Bone novels. You love her like in teen magazines. You love her like in the real-life love stories in those flimsy magazines. You love her like in a story you read in a novel. You love her like your friend told you he loves his wife.

You see, we learn everything except how Jesus loved the church. So, all we can do is what we learn, and what we learn is from our own experience. And you know how it is, right? You change your bed every night. We wonder why we have problems. Alas. It's simply because we don't know how to love. I was talking to a wife not too long ago. I said, "My dear," and she said, "I don't know what's wrong." This man. I'm doing everything I can. I did my best. "I tried everything to please him, yet he still mistreats me."

She said, "What else can I do?" I said: "Do you know anything?" "It's very common to encounter situations where someone doesn't know how to love." No matter what you do—you accept them, you give them gifts, whatever—they still insult you. They don't know how to love. They probably grew up in a situation where they never even saw love.

So, no matter how you treat them, what you give them, how you talk to them, or how comfortable you make them feel, they still insult you because they don't have the capacity to give you what you want. They don't know how to love you. Sometimes you wonder about a woman who does everything she can and yet is still beaten, and you wonder why. The reason is that he probably doesn't know how to do it. What I'm sharing with you in this series is that there is a way to find out how.
